hotels.title: Romantic Sicily Escape in the Heart of Taormina with Daily Breakfast & Rooftop Infinity Pool
hotels.description: Take your Sicilian escape above the rooftops at NH Collection Taormina, a five-star retreat in the town’s historic centre. The infinity pool gives you a front-row view of the sea beyond, with Sicilian street food and cocktails served poolside at Lu Souli. Linger over lunch, claim a lounger or head out to explore the old town. In summer, head to Zefiro’s seventh-floor rooftop, where views stretch towards Mount Etna and the ancient Greek Theatre. Modern interpretations of Sicilian recipes keep the focus firmly local, with the restaurant moving indoors during the cooler months. Between outings, carve out some time at Fusion Spa, complete with a Finnish sauna, Turkish bath and more. Explore the boutiques and cafes around nearby Porta Messina, or walk around five minutes to Taormina’s ancient Greek Theatre. When the sea beckons, head down to Isola Bella beach for a swim beside its tiny green island, then return to town for an aperitivo and an evening wander.
